skill.effect: The creature glides swiftly across open water, effortlessly ignoring obstacles and currents for a short while.

chains.weakness: Calm winds ground the unit, leaving it vulnerable to melee
observe: Hands and feet bear elongated, webbed finger-plates that catch air

journal.en: They do not swim the sea; they sail it on fingers.

plausibility.summary: Require partly buoyant bodies, body-span dorsal patagia (not finger-only area), and downwind travel while high in the swell line; cap speed boost to open shallow water and F9 wind bands.
fixes: Require partly buoyant bodies, body-span dorsal patagia (not finger-only area), and downwind travel while high in the swell line; cap speed boost to open shallow water and F9 wind bands.
